Prob115_shift18.code:
module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  load,
    input  ena,
    input  [1:0] amount,
    input  [63:0] data,
    output reg [63:0] q
);

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (load) begin
            q <= data;
        end else if (ena) begin
            case (amount)
                2'b00: begin  // shift left by 1
                    q <= q << 1;
                end
                2'b01: begin  // shift left by 8
                    q <= q << 8;
                end
                2'b10: begin  // arithmetic right shift by 1
                    q <= $signed(q) >>> 1;
                end
                2'b11: begin  // arithmetic right shift by 8
                    q <= $signed(q) >>> 8;
                end
                default: q <= q;
            endcase
        end
        // If neither load nor ena is active, q retains its previous value
    end

endmodule
